quarterly_data.quarter: eMemory press release: eMemory/PUFsecurity Showcases OCP S.A.F.E.-Approved PUFrt (10-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: PUFsecurity's PUFrt root-of-trust IP (NeoPUF unique device secrets, NeoFuse anti-fuse OTP and a NIST SP 800-90B entropy source) received OCP S.A.F.E. approval after an independent Scope 3 assessment of physical-attack resistance and is listed on the OCP Marketplace; it fully supports Caliptra 1.x and 2.x silicon IP requirements on advanced nodes. eMemory says PUFrt has been integrated into Caliptra products from ASPEED (server management BMC chips) and into security systems of several major memory manufacturers and networking-related chips.
quarterly_data.figure: OCP S.A.F.E. Scope 3 approval; Caliptra 1.x and 2.x support
quarterly_data.counterparty_role: customer (PUFrt integrated into ASPEED Caliptra products)
